@RepGolden You all need to stop posting this stuff unless you supply the specific portions of the Bill that support your claim. I won't say "Congress lies" but I will say they never give the complete truth.

The real issue isn't funding levels—it's how Washington bureaucrats mismanage every dollar. The Save America’s Rural Hospitals Act (H.R.3684) exposes the systemic rot: Medicare fraud, inflated administrative costs, and a payment structure that rewards inefficiency. While 338 facilities teeter on collapse, D.C. keeps funneling cash into bloated urban systems and foreign aid instead of fixing rural care.

Rural hospitals don’t need more Band-Aid bailouts—they need structural reform. Section 106’s wage index adjustments and Section 113’s state flexibility provisions prove targeted fixes exist without blank checks. But let’s be clear: The $1.8B Medicaid cuts to rural providers spotlight a broken system where 50% of rural births rely on a program that reimburses at half private rates. That’s unsustainable.

The solution? Audit every line item, slash bureaucratic fat, and redirect funds to frontline care—not more D.C.-mandated failure.

See how the numbers and legislative details stack up—full analysis here: https://t.co/4ZdfxWivKh
